name: Incolornis
isnote: PBDB places it in Alexornithidae, not used here; known from fragments.
sum: Small Late Cretaceous bird from the Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan known from fragmentary bones.
wsnote: About 135 mm (I. silvae) and 220 mm (the other species) long (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: A fragmentary bone from the Bissekty Formation (number in Panteleyev 1998).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Panteleyev 1998

sources.text: A. V. Panteleyev. 1998. [New species of enantiornithines (Aves: Enantiornithes) from the Upper Cretaceous of central Kyzylkum]. Russkii Ornitologicheskii Zhurnal Ekspress Vypusk 35:3-15
